kind: design only: single-cell numerics (jomission/qualification/intrinsic.py); no plant or V2.1 battery execution
declared: 2026-09-16, before any reduced-model or sensitivity output was computed
hypothesis_under_design: fixed low_sm2p0 shot background + one zero-mean intrinsic dispersion on E -> V2.1 gates with class-resolved ISI (spec amendment 1)

background.shot: tests/test_v21b_operation.py shot_chunks over all 400 neurons, mu = V_LOW class tonic, lambda 62.5 Hz, tau 2 ms, seed 21100; E columns used unchanged
background.network_targets: results/v21b_low_sm2p0.json (E rates, E rate-CV) and results/v21b_isi_classes.json (E frac_in, E CV median)

reduced_model.cells: M = 300 independent E cells (plant E count), a=0.02 b=0.2 c=-65 d=8, tonic I0 = 2.86
reduced_model.run: 4 x 5 s chunks, dt 0.1 ms, analysis windows 1-3 (V2.1 protocol)
reduced_model.recurrent_surrogate: per presynaptic class: Poisson events at K_X * r_X (plant in-degree onto E; r_X = mean of sealed low_sm2p0 window rates) into an exponential trace (tau E 2 ms, I 5 ms), increment n*mean(w) + sqrt(n)*sd(w)*N(0,1) from plant X->E weights; open loop (presynaptic rates fixed)
reduced_model.common_random_numbers: identical input streams across all conditions

validation_gate.cv_median: |mean over windows of E CV median - 0.525| <= 0.05
validation_gate.rate_cv: mean over windows of E rate-CV in [0.02, 0.07]
validation_gate.failure: verdict UNRESOLVED (existing evidence cannot estimate the width)

H1_sensitivity.homogeneous_population: all M cells at p0 * level under the background
H1_sensitivity.S_r: d ln(mean rate) / d ln p, central difference 0.9 / 1.1
H1_sensitivity.S_CV: d(E CV median) / d ln p, central difference 0.9 / 1.1
H1_sensitivity.S_rh: d(rheobase) / d ln p, central difference 0.9 / 1.1; rheobase by bisection to 0.005 with the H1 criterion (>=1 spike in last 1 s of 2 s)

biology.b: subthreshold coupling of recovery to voltage (resting potential, rheobase)

H2_H3_width_scan.distribution: p_i = p0 * g_i / mean(g), g_i = exp(s z_i), z_i standard-normal quantiles permuted by PCG64(31001); s set so sd(p)/|p0| = w exactly; E only; exact zero mean in p
H2_H3_width_scan.w_star: smallest grid width with E rate-CV >= 0.30 in every window

criteria_at_w_star.F1_plausibility: w* <= 0.5 (ASSUMED ceiling for intrinsic-parameter CV within one cortical class)
criteria_at_w_star.F2_temporal: min-window E frac_in(w*) >= min-window E frac_in(w=0) - 0.03
criteria_at_w_star.F3_silence: max-window fraction of E cells with <4 spikes <= 0.05
criteria_at_w_star.F4_runaway: max-window fraction of E cells > 60 Hz <= 0.05
criteria_at_w_star.F5_mean_rate: mean E rate in [2, 30] Hz and |r(w*) - r(0)| / r(0) <= 0.25
criteria_at_w_star.F6_bursting: fraction of dispersed cells with deterministic ISI-CV >= 0.5 at I = 9.2 (H1 protocol) <= 0.05
criteria_at_w_star.F8_not_silence_driven: min-window E rate-CV over active cells >= 0.25
criteria_at_w_star.nonfinite: any non-finite state fails the condition

H2_H3_width_scan.selection: among parameters meeting F1-F8: smallest w*; tie -> larger min-window E frac_in at w*; tie -> smaller |mean rate shift|
H2_H3_width_scan.bracket: {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} x w* on the selected parameter (prediction; execution not authorized by this checkpoint)

verdict.INTRINSIC_HETEROGENEITY_FEASIBLE: validation passes and >=1 parameter meets F1-F8
verdict.INTRINSIC_HETEROGENEITY_INFEASIBLE: validation passes and no parameter meets F1-F8

reported_not_gating: predicted E ISI gate at w* (min-window E frac_in >= 0.8): an execution PASS needs it
class viability: low_sm2p0 VIP ~130 Hz exceeds the spec VIP band [1, 80] (amendment 1); E-only dispersion changes VIP input only through E->VIP recurrence
closed-loop bound: reduced-model E rate response to a +/-0.05 native-unit shift in recurrent input
